file_path.description: Path of the file in storage to insert into.

line_number.description: 1-based line number BEFORE which content will be inserted. Use 1 to insert at the very top. Must be between 1 and (current line count + 1); an out-of-range value returns an error stating the file's actual line count.

content.description: Text to insert. May contain newlines to insert multiple lines at once.
